  MAJOR-R2-1: .solari-row no longer sets flex-wrap (round 2's fix wrapped
  the subject/state/elapsed cluster too, not just the disclosure, doubling

  DOM order, needing no wrap. New browser-dispatch-row-geometry.test.js

  round-2 HEAD, observing red for the stated reason (2 visual lines instead

  and green (3/3).

  own insertion moved the target) converted to symbol form. Audited every
  other bare line-number reference the round-2 commits added: found and
  fixed one more (condition-open-state.test.js), verified two others

  malformed item validates clean, because $defs.lane.data is never $ref'd

  design posture, untouched). The renderer's own filter is the entire
  runtime protection.

  MINOR-R2-1: new test pins the owner-ruled collapsed-by-default posture -
  non-vacuity proven by injecting an open attribute, observing red, then
  restoring byte-identical.

  MINOR-R2-2: replaced the tautological closest().contains() witness with

  box containment), all measured true live, and pointed at dom-writer.
  test.js's structural tests as the re-runnable proof. Recaptured
  screenshots using a multi-row fixture (the old single-subject fixture
  cannot visually exhibit MAJOR-R2-1 at all - disclosed). Also disclosed,
  found incidentally: a pre-existing CSS-grid row-band-stretch cosmetic

  findings, not fixed, flagged for the record given the round's swirl cap.
